AUTHOR: Soom
TITLE: Environmentally adaptive fish or no-fish classification for river video fish counters using high-performance desktop and embedded hardware
REGION: Central European rivers (Germany: Mosel/Koblenz, Malliss; 5 anonymous lowland/midland/alpine sites)
SPECIES: Binary fish/no-fish; videos include 17 freshwater species (e.g., barbel, brown trout, chub, grayling, Atlantic salmon)
DATA: 3000 Vaki River Watcher fishway counter videos from 7 European sites (own/partner data)
V_EV: Sec 2.2 / Table 5: 'A balanced dataset including six different environmental conditions: clear, low lighting, air bubbles, biofilm growth, turbidity and overexposure.' Results reported per condition (Table 5).
D2: 3000 videos split 1500 (train/test, frames 80/20 repeated random sub-sampling) / 1500 held-out validation videos
D_EV: Sec 2.4.1: 'the validation videos were held-out from training and thus contained videos that the models had not encountered before.'
R_EV: Sec 2.2: 'The 3000 videos used in this work have been collected from seven European River Watcher monitoring sites' - single dataset, no external test.
C_EV: Sec 2.7 / Table 3: 'The threshold values for each environmental condition were retrieved using Design of Experiments (DOE).' Per-condition thresholds listed in Table 3.
E_EV: Sec 2.8: 'Videos classified as "fish" or "no fish" were compared to human labels which served as the ground truth.' Only accuracy/precision/recall/F1 reported.
ARCH: Custom 12-layer VGG-style CNN (environmental condition classifier) + Gaussian blur/CLAHE + frame differencing / scanlines + rule-based binary video classifier
METR: Accuracy, precision, recall sensitivity/specificity, F1; FPPS, FPPW
NOTE: Inclusion borderline: fish/no-fish decision is made by classical motion detection (frame differencing/scanlines) with DOE-tuned thresholds; ML (CNN) only classifies environmental condition to select preprocessing. Coded INCL=Y as pipeline is a CV fish-detection system on field fishway video; verifier should check against criterion (a). Thresholds are motion/frame-count thresholds, not detector confidence scores; C1=Y applied by analogy (per-condition tuned). Turbidity etc. are human-labelled categories, not measured. Fish/no-fish final test: 500 videos randomly drawn per iteration (5 iterations) from the held-out set; split unit video. Data not shareable.
